generated_test_cases.title: Update item with description omitted (negative)
generated_test_cases.description: Verify that updating an item without providing a description triggers the branch not (description is not None) in the update_item repository function.
steps: Create a valid item via the POST / endpoint.
Call the PUT /{item_id} endpoint with a payload that includes a name but omits the description field.
Observe the response from the service layer.
expected_results: The item is updated with the new name, and the description remains unchanged.
The branch not (description is not None) is exercised, confirming that the code correctly handles missing description.

generated_test_cases.title: Update item with null description (negative)
generated_test_cases.description: Test the branch not (description is not None) by explicitly setting description to null when updating an item.
steps: Create an item with a non‑null description.
Send a PUT request to /{item_id} with JSON body where "description": null.
Check the item stored in the database.
expected_results: The description field of the item is set to null.
The code path not (description is not None) is executed.

generated_test_cases.title: Boundary test for get_db maximum concurrent connections
generated_test_cases.description: Verify that get_db can handle the maximum number of concurrent connections defined by the database pool.
preconditions: Database pool size is set to 10 connections
expected_results: First 10 sessions succeed
11th session raises a pool exhaustion error

generated_test_cases.title: Security: Ensure get_db does not expose connection string
generated_test_cases.description: Verify that get_db does not return or expose the database connection string in logs or error messages.
preconditions: Database credentials are set in environment variables
steps: Trigger a database error and capture logs
expected_results: Connection string is not present in any logs or error messages

generated_test_cases.title: Integration: Test application_initialization main branch
generated_test_cases.description: Confirm that the application initialization in main correctly sets up the FastAPI app and includes the get_db dependency.
steps: Check that the FastAPI instance is created
expected_results: FastAPI app starts without errors
get_db is registered as a dependency

generated_test_cases.title: Create item missing required field
generated_test_cases.description: POST request with missing name should be rejected, testing negative scenario.
steps: Send POST request to / with body {"description": "No name"}
Verify response status code indicates client error
expected_results: Response returns 422 Unprocessable Entity due to validation error
No item is created in the database

generated_test_cases.title: Read item with nonâ€‘existent ID
generated_test_cases.description: GET request for an item ID that does not exist should return 404.
expected_results: Response status code is 404 Not Found
Error message indicates item not found

generated_test_cases.title: Delete item when item exists
generated_test_cases.description: DELETE request on an existing item should succeed and return 204.
steps: Create an item via POST to obtain a valid item_id
expected_results: Item is removed from storage
Response status code is 204 No Content

generated_test_cases.title: Read items list handling empty result
generated_test_cases.description: GET request to list items when no items exist should return an empty list without errors.
expected_results: Response body is an empty list []
Status code 200 OK is returned

generated_test_cases.title: Update item sets new name when name is provided
generated_test_cases.description: Ensure that when a valid item exists and the update payload includes a non‑null name, the item's name is updated.
steps: Create an item with name "OldName" and description "Desc".
Call update_item with the item's id and a payload {"name": "NewName"}.
expected_results: The service updates the item's name to "NewName" while leaving description unchanged.
get_item returns the item with name "NewName" and original description.

generated_test_cases.title: Update item leaves name unchanged when name is omitted
generated_test_cases.description: Validate that providing an update payload without a name field does not modify the existing name.
steps: Create an item with name "OriginalName" and description "Desc".
Invoke update_item with the item's id and a payload {"description": "UpdatedDesc"} (no name key).
expected_results: The item's name remains "OriginalName".
The item's description is updated to "UpdatedDesc".

generated_test_cases.title: Update item sets new description when description is provided
generated_test_cases.description: Check that a non‑null description in the update payload correctly updates the item's description.
steps: Create an item with name "Name" and description "OldDesc".
Call update_item with the item's id and payload {"description": "NewDesc"}.
expected_results: The item's description changes to "NewDesc" while the name stays "Name".
get_item returns the updated description.

generated_test_cases.title: Update item leaves description unchanged when description is omitted
generated_test_cases.description: Confirm that omitting the description field in the update payload does not alter the existing description.
steps: Create an item with name "Name" and description "OriginalDesc".
Invoke update_item with the item's id and payload {"name": "NewName"} (no description key).
expected_results: The item's description remains "OriginalDesc".
The item's name is updated to "NewName".

generated_test_cases.title: Read single item when item does not exist (negative)
generated_test_cases.description: Cover the not item branch in the read_item router by requesting an item ID that is absent.
steps: Send GET request to /{invalid_id} where no item with that ID exists.
expected_results: The response status is 404 Not Found.
The not item branch is executed.
